def inspect(path):
    wb=load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=False)
    out={'file':str(path),'sheets':wb.sheetnames}
    for ws in wb.worksheets:
        rows=ws.iter_rows(values_only=True)
        header=next(rows,None)
        if header is None:
            out.setdefault('sheet_info',[]).append({'sheet':ws.title,'rows':0,'cols':0}); continue
        data=list(rows)
        ids=[r[0] for r in data if r and r[0] is not None]
        out.setdefault('sheet_info',[]).append({
            'sheet':ws.title,'rows':len(data),'cols':len(header),
            'header':[str(x) if x is not None else None for x in header],
            'id_count':len(ids),'id_unique':len(set(ids)),
            'id_min':min(ids) if ids else None,'id_max':max(ids) if ids else None,
            'id_is_1_to_n_ordered': ids==list(range(1,len(ids)+1)),
            'missing_id_rows':[i+2 for i,r in enumerate(data) if not r or r[0] is None][:10],
        })
    wb.close(); return out
